external_actor.independent_open_proof: frozen source opens new descriptors and independent root proc/receipt observations; no kcmp/syscall tracer assertion

limitations: This is QEMU synthetic HID/FTDI on recorded guest kernels, not physical hardware or wholePhase2 acceptance.
P proves startup-policy withdrawal and restoration only after explicit helper restart, not immediate revocation of an existing FD or an un-restarted policy edit.
C proves one separate root process independently opened/claimed both devices; this is not arbitrary external OFD revocation, and no CONNECT syscall/errno tracer was used.
Helper operation logs plus actual sysfs/disk observations and source control flow establish the stated defer/no-retry contract; do not call that per-ioctl tracing.
Killed epoch has no terminal resource snapshot. Later original-state restoration, journal retirement and new-epoch cleanup do not fabricate it.
Actual ELF files were not retained by these run directories; provenance is the recorded build→guest→after hash chain plus observedproc helper/probe identity.
All before/after raw bytes are rehashed. Current post-run documentation dirtiness, if any, is distinct from the recorded clean execution source guards.
